title: TriggerDataEvent
description: Message published to the trigger.data Kafka topic — by ui-orchestrator for data_refresh/data_quality_check, or by the daily native CronJob for full_pipeline (a value never exposed through POST /trigger — the caller-facing contract only knows the two on-demand analysis values). Consumed by data-runner's `consume` mode.

runId.description: UUID for on-demand runs (minted by ui-orchestrator); deterministic `daily-<YYYY-MM-DD>` for the CronJob-triggered full_pipeline run — queryable via GET /runs without needing to discover the id from logs.
